mapper.sql: SELECT INDICATOR_ID, ENTERPRISE_ID, ENTERPRISE_NAME, REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, REPORT_DATE, CALCULATION_DATE, CALCULATION_METHOD, DATA_STATUS, DATA_SOURCE, ROE, ROA, ROIC, GROSS_PROFIT_MARGIN, OPERATING_PROFIT_MARGIN, NET_PROFIT_MARGIN, EBITDA_MARGIN, COST_EXPENSE_RATIO, PERIOD_EXPENSE_RATIO, BASIC_EPS, DILUTED_EPS, CURRENT_RATIO, QUICK_RATIO, CASH_RATIO, ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO, DEBT_TO_EQUITY_RATIO, EQUITY_MULTIPLIER, INTEREST_COVERAGE_RATIO, DEBT_SERVICE_COVERAGE_RATIO, TANGIBLE_NET_WORTH_DEBT_RATIO, TOTAL_ASSET_TURNOVER, FIXED_ASSET_TURNOVER, CURRENT_ASSET_TURNOVER, INVENTORY_TURNOVER, ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE_TURNOVER, ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE_TURNOVER, WORKING_CAPITAL_TURNOVER, INVENTORY_DAYS, RECEIVABLE_DAYS, PAYABLE_DAYS, CASH_CONVERSION_CYCLE, REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE, NET_PROFIT_GROWTH_RATE, TOTAL_ASSET_GROWTH_RATE, EQUITY_GROWTH_RATE, SUSTAINABLE_GROWTH_RATE, CAPITAL_ACCUMULATION_RATE, TOTAL_ASSET_CONTRIBUTION_RATE, CAPITAL_PRESERVATION_APPRECIATION_RATE, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_REVENUE, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_NET_PROFIT, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_TOTAL_DEBT, CASH_FLOW_RATIO, CASH_FLOW_ADEQUACY_RATIO, CASH_REINVESTMENT_RATIO, CASH_DIVIDEND_COVERAGE_RATIO, MARKET_VALUE, BOOK_VALUE_PER_SHARE, PRICE_TO_BOOK_RATIO, PRICE_TO_EARNINGS_RATIO, DIVIDEND_YIELD, DIVIDEND_PAYOUT_RATIO, MARKET_TO_BOOK_RATIO, FINANCIAL_LEVERAGE, OPERATING_LEVERAGE, COMBINED_LEVERAGE, BETA_COEFFICIENT, ALTMAN_Z_SCORE, FINANCIAL_DISTRESS_RISK, CREDIT_RATING, COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE, PROFITABILITY_SCORE, SOLVENCY_SCORE, OPERATING_ABILITY_SCORE, DEVELOPMENT_ABILITY_SCORE, CASH_FLOW_SCORE, FINANCIAL_QUALITY_LEVEL, INDUSTRY_RANKING, PEER_COMPARISON_RESULT, CREATE_BY, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_BY, UPDATE_TIME, DELETED, VERSION FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_INDICATORS
mapper.select: SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, ROE, ROA, ROIC, GROSS_PROFIT_MARGIN, OPERATING_PROFIT_MARGIN, NET_PROFIT_MARGIN, PROFITABILITY_SCORE, CASE WHEN ROE >= 15 AND ROA >= 8 AND NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 10 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN ROE >= 10 AND ROA >= 5 AND NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 5 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN ROE >= 5 AND ROA >= 2 AND NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 2 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'POOR' END as profitabilityLevel FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, CURRENT_RATIO, QUICK_RATIO, CASH_RATIO, ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO, DEBT_TO_EQUITY_RATIO, INTEREST_COVERAGE_RATIO, SOLVENCY_SCORE, CASE WHEN CURRENT_RATIO >= 2.0 AND QUICK_RATIO >= 1.0 AND ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO <= 0.6 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN CURRENT_RATIO >= 1.5 AND QUICK_RATIO >= 0.8 AND ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO <= 0.7 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN CURRENT_RATIO >= 1.0 AND QUICK_RATIO >= 0.5 AND ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO <= 0.8 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'POOR' END as solvencyLevel FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, TOTAL_ASSET_TURNOVER, FIXED_ASSET_TURNOVER, INVENTORY_TURNOVER, ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE_TURNOVER, INVENTORY_DAYS, RECEIVABLE_DAYS, CASH_CONVERSION_CYCLE, OPERATING_ABILITY_SCORE, CASE WHEN TOTAL_ASSET_TURNOVER >= 1.5 AND INVENTORY_TURNOVER >= 6 AND RECEIVABLE_DAYS <= 60 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN TOTAL_ASSET_TURNOVER >= 1.0 AND INVENTORY_TURNOVER >= 4 AND RECEIVABLE_DAYS <= 90 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN TOTAL_ASSET_TURNOVER >= 0.5 AND INVENTORY_TURNOVER >= 2 AND RECEIVABLE_DAYS <= 120 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'POOR' END as operatingAbilityLevel FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE, NET_PROFIT_GROWTH_RATE, TOTAL_ASSET_GROWTH_RATE, EQUITY_GROWTH_RATE, SUSTAINABLE_GROWTH_RATE, DEVELOPMENT_ABILITY_SCORE, CASE WHEN REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE >= 20 AND NET_PROFIT_GROWTH_RATE >= 15 THEN 'HIGH_GROWTH' WHEN REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE >= 10 AND NET_PROFIT_GROWTH_RATE >= 8 THEN 'MODERATE_GROWTH' WHEN REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE >= 0 AND NET_PROFIT_GROWTH_RATE >= 0 THEN 'STABLE' ELSE 'DECLINING' END as developmentStage FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE, PROFITABILITY_SCORE, SOLVENCY_SCORE, OPERATING_ABILITY_SCORE, DEVELOPMENT_ABILITY_SCORE, CASH_FLOW_SCORE, FINANCIAL_QUALITY_LEVEL, INDUSTRY_RANKING, ALTMAN_Z_SCORE, FINANCIAL_DISTRESS_RISK, CASE WHEN COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE >= 90 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE >= 80 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE >= 70 THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE >= 60 THEN 'POOR' ELSE 'VERY_POOR' END as overallRating FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT fi.ENTERPRISE_ID, fi.ENTERPRISE_NAME, fi.ROE, fi.ROA, fi.NET_PROFIT_MARGIN, fi.CURRENT_RATIO, fi.ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO, fi.TOTAL_ASSET_TURNOVER, fi.COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fi.COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE DESC) as ranking, CASE WHEN fi.COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE >= industry_avg.avg_score * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN fi.COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE >= industry_avg.avg_score * 0.8 THEN 'AVERAGE' ELSE 'BELOW_AVERAGE' END as performanceLevel FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_INDICATORS fi CROSS JOIN ( SELECT AVG(COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE) as avg_score FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE REPORT_YEAR = #{reportYear} AND DELETED = 0 ) industry_avg WHERE fi.REPORT_YEAR = #{reportYear} AND fi.DELETED = 0 ORDER BY fi.COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN ${indicatorType} >= 20 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN ${indicatorType} >= 15 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN ${indicatorType} >= 10 THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN ${indicatorType} >= 5 THEN 'POOR' ELSE 'VERY_POOR' END as indicatorLevel, COUNT(*) as count, AVG(${indicatorType}) as avgValue, MAX(${indicatorType}) as maxValue, MIN(${indicatorType}) as minValue, STDDEV(${indicatorType}) as stdDev FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND ${indicatorType} IS NOT NULL AND DELETED = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN ${indicatorType} >= 20 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN ${indicatorType} >= 15 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN ${indicatorType} >= 10 THEN 'NORMAL' WHEN ${indicatorType} >= 5 THEN 'POOR' ELSE 'VERY_POOR' END ORDER BY avgValue DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_STATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) as verifiedCount, AVG(COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE) as avgComprehensiveScore, AVG(ROE) as avgROE, AVG(ROA) as avgROA, AVG(NET_PROFIT_MARGIN) as avgNetProfitMargin, AVG(CURRENT_RATIO) as avgCurrentRatio, AVG(ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO) as avgAssetLiabilityRatio, COUNT(CASE WHEN FINANCIAL_QUALITY_LEVEL = 'EXCELLENT' THEN 1 END) as excellentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN FINANCIAL_DISTRESS_RISK = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highRiskCount, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as statisticsTime FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE DELETED = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATA_STATUS = 'VERIFIED' THEN 1 END) as verifiedCount, AVG(COMPREHENSIVE_SCORE) as avgComprehensiveScore, AVG(ROE) as avgROE, AVG(ROA) as avgROA, AVG(NET_PROFIT_MARGIN) as avgNetProfitMargin, AVG(CURRENT_RATIO) as avgCurrentRatio, AVG(ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO) as avgAssetLiabilityRatio, COUNT(CASE WHEN FINANCIAL_QUALITY_LEVEL = 'EXCELLENT' THEN 1 END) as excellentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN FINANCIAL_DISTRESS_RISK = 'HIGH' THEN 1 END) as highRiskCount, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as statisticsTime FROM GZCT_FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE DELETED = 0
WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = '0' ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR DESC, REPORT_PERIOD DESC
WHERE REPORT_YEAR = #{reportYear} AND DELETED = '0' ORDER BY ENTERPRISE_NAME, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, ROE, ROA, ROIC, GROSS_PROFIT_MARGIN, OPERATING_PROFIT_MARGIN, NET_PROFIT_MARGIN, PROFITABILITY_SCORE, CASE WHEN ROE >= 15 AND ROA >= 8 AND NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 10 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN ROE >= 10 AND ROA >= 5 AND NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 5 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN ROE >= 5 AND ROA >= 2 AND NET_PROFIT_MARGIN >= 2 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'POOR' END as profitabilityLevel FROM FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = '0' ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, CURRENT_RATIO, QUICK_RATIO, CASH_RATIO, ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO, DEBT_TO_EQUITY_RATIO, INTEREST_COVERAGE_RATIO, SOLVENCY_SCORE, CASE WHEN CURRENT_RATIO >= 2.0 AND QUICK_RATIO >= 1.0 AND ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO <= 0.6 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN CURRENT_RATIO >= 1.5 AND QUICK_RATIO >= 0.8 AND ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO <= 0.7 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN CURRENT_RATIO >= 1.0 AND QUICK_RATIO >= 0.5 AND ASSET_LIABILITY_RATIO <= 0.8 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'POOR' END as solvencyLevel FROM FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = '0' ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, TOTAL_ASSET_TURNOVER, FIXED_ASSET_TURNOVER, INVENTORY_TURNOVER, ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE_TURNOVER, INVENTORY_DAYS, RECEIVABLE_DAYS, CASH_CONVERSION_CYCLE, OPERATING_ABILITY_SCORE, CASE WHEN TOTAL_ASSET_TURNOVER >= 1.5 AND INVENTORY_TURNOVER >= 6 AND RECEIVABLE_DAYS <= 60 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN TOTAL_ASSET_TURNOVER >= 1.0 AND INVENTORY_TURNOVER >= 4 AND RECEIVABLE_DAYS <= 90 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN TOTAL_ASSET_TURNOVER >= 0.5 AND INVENTORY_TURNOVER >= 2 AND RECEIVABLE_DAYS <= 120 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'POOR' END as operatingAbilityLevel FROM FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = '0' ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE, NET_PROFIT_GROWTH_RATE, TOTAL_ASSET_GROWTH_RATE, EQUITY_GROWTH_RATE, SUSTAINABLE_GROWTH_RATE, DEVELOPMENT_ABILITY_SCORE, CASE WHEN REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE >= 20 AND NET_PROFIT_GROWTH_RATE >= 15 THEN 'HIGH_GROWTH' WHEN REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE >= 10 AND NET_PROFIT_GROWTH_RATE >= 8 THEN 'MODERATE_GROWTH' WHEN REVENUE_GROWTH_RATE >= 0 AND NET_PROFIT_GROWTH_RATE >= 0 THEN 'STABLE' ELSE 'DECLINING' END as developmentStage FROM FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = '0' ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD

SELECT REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_REVENUE, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_NET_PROFIT, OPERATING_CASH_FLOW_TO_TOTAL_DEBT, CASH_FLOW_RATIO, CASH_FLOW_ADEQUACY_RATIO, CASH_REINVESTMENT_RATIO, CASH_FLOW_SCORE, CASE WHEN CASH_FLOW_RATIO >= 1.0 AND CASH_FLOW_ADEQUACY_RATIO >= 1.0 THEN 'EXCELLENT' WHEN CASH_FLOW_RATIO >= 0.5 AND CASH_FLOW_ADEQUACY_RATIO >= 0.5 THEN 'GOOD' WHEN CASH_FLOW_RATIO >= 0.2 AND CASH_FLOW_ADEQUACY_RATIO >= 0.2 THEN 'NORMAL' ELSE 'POOR' END as cashFlowLevel FROM FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND REPORT_YEAR BETWEEN #{startYear} AND #{endYear} AND DELETED = '0' ORDER BY REPORT_YEAR, REPORT_PERIOD
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM FINANCIAL_INDICATORS WHERE CREATE_TIME < (SYSDATE - #{days}) AND DATA_STATUS = 'CALCULATING'
